messages:
alex: Quick sync — need to lock newsletter + benchmark webinar launch flow today. Key tasks: segmentation, send windows (NA/EU/APAC), CTA split (register vs on-demand), and inbound lead routing for trial cohorts. Can we finalise by EOD? Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-example

maria: In-scope cohorts: TRIAL_ACTIVE_7D, TRIAL_IDLE_14_PLUS, ENTERPRISE_POC, OSS_CONTRIBUTORS. Also add VIPs (partners/early adopters).

sam: Send windows recs based on engagement: NA -> 10am PT, EU -> 11am CET, APAC -> 10am SGT. Stagger to avoid SMTP spikes.

jamie: CTA split: 50/50 register-live vs watch-on-demand. Newsletter hero should A/B subject: benchmark stat vs human story. I have subject drafts.

noah: Routing rule idea: if a user clicks >=2 product CTAs OR opens >3x in 48h -> tag as \"high_intent_webinar\" and push to SDR webhook. Else -> enroll in 3-email micronudge nurture.

maria: Will generate 6 headline variants with personalization tokens (company, feature used). Ill output CSV.

alex: Owners: jamie -> templates & CTA split; sam -> schedule & ramp; noah -> routing rules & webhook; maria -> subjects & tokens. Previews by 4pm? :eyes: 

deploy-bot: Preview ready for seed accounts: https://preview.redwood.ai/emails/3124001234/seed (note: alt text missing on hero image flagged, DKIM passed)

jamie: Template uploaded (sheet tab: templates). Question: benchmark stat in copy shows "~33% latency reduction". Should we round?

alex: Use "32% median latency reduction" QA cleared that phrasing.

sam: Ramp plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 hours per region. Cron snippet for staging:
```
# NA 10am PT
0 17 * * * send_campaign --audience=NA_10pct
# ramp to 50% @ +1h
# ramp to 100% @ +3h
```

noah: Routing pseudo-rule for devs:
```
if clicks >= 2 and days_since_signup <= 30:
  tag=high_intent_webinar -> POST /sdr/webhook
else:
  enroll in nurture_micronudge_flow
```
PR in automations repo: https://github.com/redwood/automations/pull/456 — ops: need webhook secret.

maria: Subject options (preview):
1) "See how teams cut median latency by 32%" (stat + invite)
2) "How ACME sped up inference — webinar + guide" (case study)
3) "Benchmarks + playbook: faster inference in production" (broad)
4) "Quick wins for lowering token costs (webinar)" (cost angle)
Which two for A/B?

alex: A/B 1 vs 2. Seed 20k per region, winner moves to full send at hour 2. :shipit:

jamie: I'll add dynamic tokens and watch-on-demand fallback copy.

sam: Setting schedule and staged ramp in campaign manager. Monitoring bounces and throttle.

noah: PR linked and tests pass. Tagging ops for webhook secret configuration.

maria: Deliverability checks running across major inboxes; subject CSV & test plan by 2pm.

alex: Final preview link by 3:45pm, jamie, so I can sign off. Thanks — small coordinated ship today. :tada:
